summary: MARSWALK is an interactive Martian surface mapping and interplanetary survival platform designed to help future astronauts and mission planners navigate Mars safely. Built around four integrated modules—Mission Planner, Telemetry & Map, Science & Imagery, and Survival Playbook—MARSWALK unifies NASA orbital datasets with live surface operations. Using MOLA elevation cross-sections, Mars Trek EPSG:4326 imagery, Supabase landmark coordinates, and a real-time FastAPI geological database, crews can toggle elevation, slope, radiation, and communications layers while evaluating conservative, science-rich, or emergency return routes. The platform also monitors rover battery and oxygen margins, calibrates mission parameters via CSV traverse manifests, and provides step-by-step contingency protocols for pressure loss, power failure, communications blackouts, and dust storms across strategic landing zones including Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, Utopia Planitia, and Arsia Mons. By turning complex planetary science into actionable field intelligence, MARSWALK empowers safer, smarter human exploration on Mars.

MARSWALK — Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map

What It Does & How It Works

MARSWALK is an interactive interplanetary survival guide and layered Martian surface mapping platform built to bridge orbital planetary science with real-time astronaut and rover navigation. The platform operates through four tightly integrated modules:

1. Mission Planner & MOLA Profiles: Combines 2D and 3D terrain context with toggleable elevation, slope, radiation, and communications layers. Users can compare conservative, science-rich, and emergency return traverse profiles, inspect Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter (MOLA) elevation cross-sections against slope limits, rover battery reserves, and oxygen margins, and import/export mission traverse manifests as CSV files to calibrate route parameters automatically.

2. Telemetry & Mars Trek Simulation: Plots verified NASA landmarks from Supabase onto Mars Trek EPSG:4326 tiles, enabling crews to place custom waypoints, monitor live battery, comms, velocity, and mission clock telemetry, and run interactive traverse simulations.

3. Science & Imagery Explorer: Powered by a real-time FastAPI search engine, this module filters craters, valleys, and mineral zones while pairing geological metadata with NASA orbital imagery.

4. Survival Playbook & Emergency Protocols: Provides operational briefings for four strategic landing zones (Utopia Planitia, Gale Crater, Jezero Crater, and Arsia Mons) alongside six step-by-step contingency procedures covering suit pressure loss, power drops, communications blackouts, and dust storms.

Benefits & Intended Impact

Planetary surface data is often fragmented across raw scientific archives and static maps. MARSWALK consolidates terrain hazards, life-support margins, scientific targets, and emergency response checklists into one unified mission-control interface—reducing cognitive load during surface EVAs, improving traverse safety, and helping both mission planners and students explore Mars through authentic NASA datasets.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used

We developed MARSWALK using modern web and data-engineering technologies, including TypeScript / JavaScript, React, HTML5, and CSS3 for the high-contrast mission-control frontend, Python and FastAPI for real-time geological database querying and CSV manifest processing, Supabase (PostgreSQL) for spatial landmark storage, and NASA Mars Trek (EPSG:4326) tiles, MOLA topographic datasets, and NASA planetary imagery APIs for geospatial rendering.

Creativity & Key Factors Considered

Rather than building a passive map viewer, we designed MARSWALK around real human-spaceflight constraints—balancing scientific discovery against physical slope thresholds, communications line-of-sight, radiation exposure, and oxygen/battery point-of-no-return limits. Combining customizable traverse risk profiles, CSV manifest calibration, and actionable emergency playbooks makes MARSWALK both a practical mission-planning simulator and an engaging educational tool.
